empty.title: Nothing matches that
empty.body: Try a different name, or clear the filters.

notFound.title: This place is not on Yalla any more
notFound.body: It may have closed or stopped taking bookings. Go back and pick another.

empty.title: No branches
empty.body: This venue has no locations listed yet.

notFound.title: We could not find that booking
notFound.body: It may have been made with another number, or on another phone.

booking.noTimesLeft: No times left to book on this day. Pick another day.

atTable.hint: At the venue? Open your tab on the table you booked.

floorPlan.title: Pick a table
floorPlan.comingSoon: The floor plan for this branch appears here.
floorPlan.notFound: That branch could not be found.

empty.title: No bookings yet
empty.body: Find a table and it will show up here.

detail.title: Your booking
detail.cancelFree: It is free to cancel now, and the table goes back to others.
detail.cancelLate: This is past the free-cancellation time, but cancelling still helps far more than not turning up.
detail.cancelFailed: We could not cancel that. Try again.

signedOut.title: Your bookings are kept under your number
signedOut.body: Confirm your number to see them.

table.title: Table {{label}}
table.shortWindow: That is shorter than a usual sitting here. Other tables may have no limit.
table.needsApproval: A party this size needs the venue to confirm. You will hear back shortly.

unavailable.occupied: Someone is sitting here right now.
unavailable.held: Someone else is booking this table.
unavailable.outOfService: This table is out of service.
unavailable.pastLeadTime: Too soon to book this table.
unavailable.tooLarge: Kept for larger parties. Pick a smaller table.
unavailable.tooFarAhead: Too far ahead to book yet.
unavailable.invalidTime: That time does not exist on this date — the clocks change.

table.freeCancellationPassed: The free-cancellation time has passed. Cancelling still helps the venue.

verify.phoneBody: We ask for this only to hold the table, so the venue can reach you if something changes.

error.wrongCode_one: That code is not right. {{count}} attempt left.
error.wrongCode_other: That code is not right. {{count}} attempts left.
error.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
error.rateLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again after {{time}}.
error.network: No connection. Check your signal and try again.
error.wrongCodeNoCount: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
error.codeSpent: That code has had too many tries. Ask for a new one.
error.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many codes asked for. Try again a little later.

confirm.title: Confirm your table

error.tableTaken: Table {{label}} was just taken. Here is what is free now.
error.leadTime: That time is too soon now. The earliest we can book is {{time}}.
error.generic: We could not complete that. Nothing was booked.
error.tableOccupied: Someone has just sat down at table {{label}}. Here is what is free now.
error.busy: Someone else is booking that table this second. Tap confirm again.
error.commandInUse: That attempt could not be used. Tap confirm to try again.
error.branchUnavailable: This venue is not taking bookings right now.
error.unknownOutcome: The connection dropped before the venue answered, so we cannot tell yet whether you have the table. Check again — it will not book twice.

confirm.namePlaceholder: The name the venue asks for at the door
confirm.tableError: We could not check this table. Try again.
confirm.tableMissing: That table is not on the plan any more. Go back and pick another.
confirm.phoneMissing: We need to confirm your number before booking.

success.pendingBody: The venue will confirm shortly. We will let you know.
success.shareMessage: I booked table {{table}} at {{venue}} ({{branch}}) for {{time}}. Code {{code}}.
success.atTableHint: When you arrive, tap “I’m at my table” on your booking — or scan the QR on the table.

net.offlineBody: Check your connection and try again.
net.serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
net.notAvailableBody: The backend does not offer this yet. Nothing is wrong with your phone.
net.signedOut: Your session ended. Verify your number again when you reserve.

scan.title: Scan your table
scan.lead: The code is on your table, usually on a little stand.
scan.noAccount: No sign-up and no phone number. Scan and you are in.
scan.why: The camera is used for one thing: reading the code on your table.
scan.deniedBody: No problem — type your table code or booking code instead.
scan.unavailableBody: This device cannot scan, so type your table code or booking code.
scan.aiming: Point the camera at the code on your table
scan.manualBody: The long code printed under the QR on your table, your booking code, or a link from the host.
scan.manualPlaceholder: Table code, booking code or link

result.opened: Your tab is open and you are the host.
result.pending: You have asked to join. The host taps approve and you are in.
result.alreadyOn: You are already on this tab.

error.outOfService: Table {{label}} is out of service. Ask a waiter for another one.
error.unknownCode: That code does not match a table here. Check it again, or ask a waiter.
error.tabClosed: That tab has already been closed and paid. A waiter can open a new one.
error.network: No connection. Nothing was opened — try again.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
error.empty: Type your table code, booking code or link.
error.notEnabled: Ordering from your phone is not switched on here. A waiter will take your order.
error.branchUnavailable: This place is not opening tabs right now. Ask a waiter.
error.uncertain: We did not hear back. Scan again — it will not open a second tab.
error.bookingNotFound: No booking of yours has that code. Check it, or ask a member of staff.
error.bookingTooEarly: Your table is not being held yet. You can open your tab from {{time}}.
error.bookingTooEarlyOnDay: Your table is not being held yet. You can open your tab on {{date}} from {{time}}.
error.bookingTooEarlyNoTime: Your table is not being held yet. Try again closer to your booking.
error.bookingEnded: That booking is over. Ask a member of staff to open a tab for you.
error.bookingNotActive: That booking is not one you can open a tab on. Ask a member of staff.
error.bookingPending: The venue has not confirmed this booking yet. Ask a member of staff.
error.bookingCancelledByYou: This booking was cancelled. Ask a member of staff to open a tab for you.
error.bookingCancelledByVenue: The venue cancelled this booking. Ask a member of staff.
error.bookingNoShow: This booking is marked as a no-show. Ask a member of staff to open a tab for you.
error.signInNeeded: Confirm your number to use a booking code. The code on the table needs no account.

tab.title: Table {{label}}
tab.leaveBody: You can scan the code again to come back.
tab.leaveHostBody: You opened this tab. Whoever has been on it longest takes it over. If nobody else is on it, a waiter can close it.
tab.leaveFailed: We could not leave the tab. Try again.

orders.title: Orders
orders.placeholder: Ordering arrives next. Your items and the running total appear here.

tab.closedBody: It has been paid and settled. Scan again to start a new one.
tab.notFoundBody: Scan the code on your table to open a new one.
tab.offline: No connection. This is the last state we saw.

accessEnded.title: You are not on this tab any more
accessEnded.body: The tab has closed, or you were taken off it. Scan the code on your table to join again.

tab.hostCannotLeave: Nobody else is on the tab to take it over, so you cannot leave it yet. A waiter can close it for you.
tab.loadError: We could not load your tab.
tab.closingBanner: The bill has been asked for, so nothing more can be ordered on this tab.

pending.title: Waiting for the host
pending.body: {{name}} just has to tap approve on their phone. It takes a second.
pending.bodyNoName: The host just has to tap approve on their phone. It takes a second.
pending.menuNote: You can read the menu and prices right now. The rest of the tab appears once you are approved.
pending.endedTitle: You are not on this tab
pending.endedBody: The host did not add you, or the tab has closed. If you are at this table, ask them, or scan once more.

invite.title: Invite to this tab
invite.body: Have them scan this, or send them the link.
invite.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available here, so the link is copied instead.
invite.expiresIn_one: This link works for {{count}} more minute.
invite.expiresIn_other: This link works for {{count}} more minutes.
invite.expired: This link has expired. Make a new one.
invite.error: We could not make a link. Try again.
invite.notHost: Only whoever opened the tab can invite people. Ask them to show the code on their phone.

people.title: People on this tab
people.removeBody: They come off the tab. Anything already ordered stays on it.
people.hostOnly: Only the host can change this.
people.failed: That did not go through. Nothing changed — try again.
people.payNeedsTotal: Paying needs the total, so that went on too.
people.totalOffTurnsOffPay: With the total hidden there is nothing to pay against, so paying went off.
people.alwaysOwnItems: Everyone always sees menu prices and their own items. Hiding the total hides the table total and other people's items — never someone's own order.
people.whyHide: Hiding the total is for when you are treating everyone. That is why paying starts off.
people.permissionsUnknown: What this person can do is not shown until you set it. These start from the table's setting, and nothing changes until you save.

menu.title: Menu
menu.pricesOnly: Prices only for now — ordering arrives soon.
menu.emptyBody: This branch has not published a menu.
menu.error: We could not load the menu.
menu.offlineNoCache: The menu has not been loaded on this phone yet, and there is no signal to fetch it.

waiter.title: What do you need?
waiter.sent: Asked for: {{what}}. Someone will come over.
waiter.failed: That did not go through. Try again, or catch someone's eye.
waiter.sentAtTable: We have told the counter — {{what}}, table {{label}}.
waiter.rateLimited_one: Your table has asked several times in the last minute. A waiter is on the way.
waiter.rateLimited_other: Your table has asked several times in the last {{count}} minutes. A waiter is on the way.
waiter.rateLimitedNoWindow: Your table has asked several times already. A waiter is on the way.

join.title: Joining a tab
join.failedBody: Ask for a new one, or scan the code on your table.

error.expired: That invitation has expired or been replaced. Ask the host for a new link.

tray.title: Your order
tray.sharedExplained: Shared items are split evenly between everyone at the table right now. Whoever joins later will not be on this one.

bar.stillNotSent: Still here — nothing has gone to the kitchen

sent.title: Sent to the kitchen
sent.replayed: It had already reached the kitchen, and it went only once.

failed.offline: No signal, so this order has not been placed.
failed.error: This order has not been placed.
failed.askWaiter: Nothing was sent to the kitchen. Try again in a moment, or ask a waiter and they will take it.
failed.soldOut: {{item}} has just sold out, so nothing was sent.
failed.soldOutHint: Take it out of your order and send the rest, or ask a waiter what else there is.
failed.closing: The bill has been asked for on this table, so nothing more can go on it.
failed.closingHint: Nothing was sent to the kitchen. If you still want this, a waiter can add it.
failed.uncertain: We could not tell whether this order reached the kitchen.
failed.uncertainHint: Check again sends the same order once more. If it already arrived, it is not placed twice.
failed.forbidden: You cannot order on this tab right now.
failed.notSent: Nothing was sent to the kitchen.

tray.lockedHint: We could not tell whether your last send reached the kitchen. Check before changing anything.

bill.title: The bill so far
bill.error: We could not load the bill.
bill.hiddenTotal: The table total is kept to whoever opened the tab. You are still shown every price and everything you ordered.

settle.title: Settling up
settle.error: We could not work out the shares.
settle.people: Manage who is on the tab

mode.title: How you are splitting it
mode.locked: Someone has already paid, so this stays as it is.

hostPaysEverything.title: One person pays
hostPaysEverything.body: Whoever opened the tab settles the whole bill.

everyonePaysOwnItems.title: Everyone pays for their own
everyonePaysOwnItems.body: Shared items and the service charge are split between you.

anyonePaysAnyAmount.title: Sort it out between you
anyonePaysAnyAmount.body: Anyone can hand over any amount until the bill is covered.

mode.notHost: Only whoever opened the tab can change this.
mode.closing: The bill has been asked for, so the split cannot change now.
mode.failed: That did not change. Try again.

shares.title: Who owes what
shares.body: Shared items and the service charge are already included in each amount.
shares.absorbed: Includes {{amount}} for someone who left the tab.
shares.hidden: The table total is kept to whoever opened the tab, so only your share is shown.

pay.title: Paying
pay.body: Payment is taken at the table in cash. Ask for the bill and a waiter will come over with it.

optIn.explain: We can remind you an hour before, so you can cancel in one tap if plans change.
optIn.granted: We will remind you an hour before.
optIn.declined: No reminder will arrive for this booking. Your table is still held.

actions.hint: Cancelling late is far better for the restaurant than not turning up.
actions.extended: The table is held until {{time}}. That was your one extension.
actions.alreadyExtended: You have already let them know — the table had its one extension. If you need longer, the restaurant will decide.
actions.cancelled: Cancelled. Thank you for saying so.
actions.offline: No signal, so nothing changed. Try again when you are back online.
actions.failed: That did not go through, so nothing changed.
actions.unknown: We could not read this booking, so there is nothing safe to offer here.

stale.seated: You are already at the table. Enjoy it.
stale.noShow: This booking was marked as a no-show.
stale.unknown: This booking is no longer one you can change here.

actions.holdNotActive: Your table is held from the booking time. You can ask to keep it once it starts.
actions.extensionsNotOffered: This venue does not hold tables for late arrivals. Call them if you are running late.
actions.keepTableHint: Running late? Let them know once, and the table is held a little longer.

blocked.pending: You can order once the host lets you on the tab.
blocked.notAllowed: The host has not turned on ordering for you. Ask them, or a waiter.
blocked.closing: The bill has been asked for, so nothing more can go on this tab.
blocked.removed: You are no longer on this tab.
